name: purgedcv: purged and combinatorial cross-validation
license: MIT License; actual LICENSE states Copyright (c) 2026 Evgenii Lazarev
methods: Interval-overlap purging using feature-start through label-end information intervals
PurgedKFold with optional time, observation, or fractional embargo
Optional path reconstruction, probabilistic/deflated Sharpe and backtest-overfitting diagnostics
reuseDecision: Implement the published interval-purging method independently in TypeScript for Zax's paper-only forward-return classifier. Do not import or wrap the stale Python snapshot; if any material upstream code is later copied, source it from canonical eslazarev/purged-cross-validation at a pinned release and retain the complete MIT notice.
requirements: Sorted local historical rows with featureStart, decisionTime, and labelEnd for every labelled observation
A declared feature lookback and forward-label horizon; reject future-aware features, missing/out-of-order bars, and unresolved end labels
Initial validation: expanding walk-forward, nSplits=5, testSize equal to intended deployment block, full interval purge, and an untouched final chronological holdout
No package account, provider registration, paid access, user-data upload, or brokerage credential is required
No runtime network access; any separate Coinbase public-data refresh must respect the documented 10 requests/second per-IP limit, burst 15
